entities.label: Disease
entities.description: A disease, disorder, cancer, or medical condition.

entities.label: Symptom
entities.description: A sign, symptom, or clinical manifestation.

entities.label: Treatment
entities.description: A therapy, procedure, surgery, or intervention (e.g. brachytherapy, radiation, chemotherapy).

entities.label: Drug
entities.description: A medication, drug, or pharmacological agent.

entities.label: AnatomicalStructure
entities.description: An organ, gland, tissue, or body part (e.g. prostate, urethra, lung).

entities.label: DiagnosticTest
entities.description: A diagnostic test, imaging modality, biopsy, or screening method.

properties.name: kind
properties.description: lab test, imaging, biopsy, screening, etc.

entities.label: RiskFactor
entities.description: A risk factor or cause associated with a disease (e.g. smoking, age, exposure).

entities.label: Biomarker
entities.description: A biomarker, protein, hormone, antigen, or measurable substance (e.g. PSA).

entities.label: Pathogen
entities.description: An infectious agent — virus, bacterium, or other pathogen (e.g. HPV).

entities.label: BodySystem
entities.description: A body system (e.g. reproductive, respiratory, immune).

relations.label: CAUSES
relations.description: A risk factor, pathogen, or disease causes a disease or symptom.

relations.label: TREATS
relations.description: A treatment or drug is used to treat a disease.

relations.label: SYMPTOM_OF
relations.description: A symptom is a manifestation of a disease.

relations.label: DIAGNOSED_BY
relations.description: A disease is diagnosed or detected by a test.

relations.label: AFFECTS
relations.description: A disease affects an anatomical structure or body system.

relations.label: PART_OF
relations.description: An anatomical structure is part of a larger structure or body system.

relations.label: RISK_FACTOR_FOR
relations.description: A risk factor increases the risk of a disease.

relations.label: PREVENTS
relations.description: A treatment or drug prevents a disease.

relations.label: PRODUCES
relations.description: An anatomical structure produces a biomarker or substance.

relations.label: INDICATES
relations.description: A biomarker or test result indicates a disease.

relations.label: HAS_SUBTYPE
relations.description: A disease has a subtype or variant.

relations.label: SIDE_EFFECT_OF
relations.description: A symptom is a side effect of a treatment or drug.

relations.label: ADMINISTERED_TO
relations.description: A treatment or drug is administered to an anatomical structure.
